user.title: School Schedule
user.description: Set up a new schedule for a child.

abort.already_configured: A schedule already exists for this child.

error.subject_required: Please provide a subject (optional for breaks).
error.slot_taken: This lesson number is already taken for this weekday.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Set the federal state for vacations and public holidays.

add_lesson.title: Add lesson
add_lesson.description: Add a new lesson to the schedule.

add_lesson.name: Add lesson
add_lesson.description: Adds a lesson to a child's schedule.

remove_lesson.name: Remove lesson
remove_lesson.description: Removes a lesson from a child's schedule.

update_lesson.name: Update lesson
update_lesson.description: Updates the data of an existing lesson.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the schedule for a given weekday.

set_federal_state.name: Set federal state
set_federal_state.description: Sets the federal state used for vacation and public holiday calculation.

mark_sick_day.name: Mark sick day
mark_sick_day.description: Marks a day as a sick day (absence tracking). Defaults to today; backdating and pre-marking via date parameter are supported.

unmark_sick_day.name: Remove sick day
unmark_sick_day.description: Removes the sick-day mark for a day. Defaults to today.

mark_sick_range.name: Sick note (from-to)
mark_sick_range.description: Marks all days from start to end date (inclusive) as sick. Both dates are required.

update_sick_day.name: Edit sick day
update_sick_day.description: Updates the note of an existing sick day. The day must already be marked as sick.

mark_lesson_cancelled.name: Cancel lesson
mark_lesson_cancelled.description: Marks a single lesson on a concrete date as cancelled (teacher sick, field trip, substitute plan) - without changing the weekly schedule.

unmark_lesson_cancelled.name: Undo cancellation
unmark_lesson_cancelled.description: Removes the cancellation mark of a single lesson - the lesson takes place again.
